title: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements Service Level Schedule
content:
Emergency response levels attached to each tier of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. Credit amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Response commitment (minutes) | Dispatch priority rank | Water and fire service call fees waived | SLA credit per dispatch | SLA credit cap per term | SLA credits per mitigation job | SLA claim window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 180 | 4 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 120 | 3 | No | 75.00 | 300.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 90 | 2 | Yes | 150.00 | 750.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 60 | 1 | Yes | 250.00 | 1,500.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 60 | 1 | Yes | 250.00 | 5,000.00 | 1 | 45 |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 120 | 2 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |

Caps shown without separators: Platinum 1500, Portfolio 5000.

## What each column means

- **Response commitment**: the guaranteed on-site arrival for the customer's emergency calls, measured from the booked call, in minutes.
- **Dispatch priority rank**: the dispatch priority among simultaneous emergency calls, 1 being highest.
- **Water and fire service call fees waived**: whether water and fire emergency service call fees are waived on the customer's jobs dispatched while the agreement is active.
- **SLA credit per dispatch**: the credit when an emergency dispatch for the customer misses the response commitment, per dispatch.
- **SLA credit cap per term**: the most SLA credit posted in one agreement term.
- **SLA credits per mitigation job**: the number of SLA credits allowed per mitigation job.
- **SLA claim window**: calendar days after a missed-response dispatch within which the customer may claim the SLA credit.

## Observations from the schedule

- The Platinum Priority and Portfolio Master Service Agreements share the 60-minute commitment, rank 1 and the 250.00 credit; they differ in the cap per term (1,500.00 against 5,000.00) and the claim window (30 against 45 calendar days).
- The Ready Profile Service Agreement carries a 180-minute commitment but a credit, cap, per-job allowance and claim window of zero.
- Service call fees are waived at the Gold Priority, Platinum Priority and Portfolio Master tiers only.
